description:
Hello! My name is Sumant Suhas Pakhare. I am a Master's student in Robotics Systems Engineering at RWTH Aachen University, Germany, with a background in Mechanical Engineering specializing in Robotics.

I am passionate about robotics, artificial intelligence, automation, data analytics, and developing innovative technologies that solve real-world problems. My interests lie in combining engineering, software development, and emerging technologies to create sustainable and impactful solutions.
